article.title: Is Burnham just Starmer with vibes? The same lobby groups funded both
article.summary: Is Burnham just Starmer with vibes? The same lobby groups funded bothSubmitted byJoe GillonMon, 08/31/2026 - 10:51Big business and pro-Israel interests have dominated the Labour Party from Blair to Starmer. The new PM has little time to show he's not just that system's new faceBritain's Prime Minister Andy Burnham talks with staff during a visit to a Sainsbury's supermarket in London on 26 August 2026 (Richard Pohle/AFP)OnWhen he became prime minister this summer, Andy Burnham promised to end 40 years of neoliberalism. It was a bold declaration, and stood in contrast to the dull managerialism and endless staged relaunches by his predecessor, Keir Starmer.But less than 50 days since he became PM, it is clear that Burnham is failing to live up to his promise.
